integrity: Proof and finite verification included; no independent external validation or audit has been performed. The alternate smooth characteristic-three reduction is not claimed to equal this nonnormal special fibre.
scientific_limitations: Only the fixed coefficientwise integral Schur model in characteristic three. The polynomial and general ruled-line form occur in a 2009 normal-form classification in other characteristics and are not novel. The line classification is set-theoretic, not the nonreduced Fano scheme. Historical priority of the wild-characteristic invariants remains provisional.
title: Frobenius-scroll normalization and square conductor of the characteristic-three Schur quartic
